mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.15% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, triggering Federal Reserve tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1 > 12500) and housing starts strength (HOUST > 500) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive equity returns through higher corporate sales over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 > 12500 and HOUST > 500.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) creates wage pressures that erode corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) reflects healthy manufacturing activity, signaling corporate earnings growth that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 500 units signal weakening consumer demand for durable goods, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to reduced sales forecasts.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 500.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) combined with low rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2) indicates Fed policy lag, prompting tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales (RSAFS > 350000) indicate sustained consumer spending, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 350000.
